key_idea: By Cauchy-Schwarz (or Lagrange multipliers) the optimum puts x_i proportional to t_i, giving p^2 / sum(t_i).
sketch: Minimising sum x_i^2/t_i subject to sum x_i = p: equal marginal cost 2x_i/t_i means x_i = p*t_i/T, total stress p^2/T where T = sum t_i. Read input, sum the t_i in 64-bit (up to 1e14), print p*p/T in long double with 10 decimals. O(n). Pitfalls: p*p up to 1e18 so compute in floating point or 64-bit carefully; print enough digits for 1e-6 relative error.
